newsitem.title: CANADA: Thomson Corp to issue C$250 mln debentures.
newsitem.headline: Thomson Corp to issue C$250 mln debentures.

text.p: Thomson Corp said on Wednesday it agreed to issue C$250 million of 7.15 percent debentures, due 2006.
The issue will be underwritten by Toronto-Dominion Securities, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, RBC Dominion Securities Inc, ScotiaMcLeod Inc, Nesbitt Burns Inc and Midland Walwyn Capital Inc.
The debentures will be priced at 99.53 percent of their principal amount and will bear interest at 7.15 percent, payable semi-annually on April 23 and October 23 starting April 23, 1997.
They will be direct unsecured obligations of Thomson and will mature on October 23, 2006.
Thomson said it would use proceeds to repay debt incurred by the company on the issuance of commercial paper. The offering is expected to close October 23.
